title: A signed-in caller reaches account, password and recovery through the provider's self-service surface
asA: operator signed in through an OAuth2 provider who wants to change their password or set up MFA
iWant: the project to send me to the provider's hosted account surface rather than owning a credential-change form
soThat: credential material never leaves the identity source

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider record with `credentialSelfService: true` and no `accountUrl` refuses at boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider record whose `credentialSelfService` is `true` and whose `accountUrl` is absent
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provider adapter runs its boot-time validation
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot refuses with stable-coded `OAUTH2_ACCOUNT_URL_MISSING` naming the provider id; the audit sink records one `oauth2.account_url_missing` event

acceptanceCriteria.description: `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl(principal)` returns the resolved provider `accountUrl` for the caller's provider. Applying-agent responsibility: The applying agent sets each provider record's `accountUrl` value against the provider's documented self-service origin. The AC binds the shape; the value belongs to the applied project.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller signed in through provider `google` and a provider record for `google` whose `accountUrl` is `https://myaccount.google.com`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return value is exactly `https://myaccount.google.com`; the helper appends no query parameters, no fragment, and no additional path segment

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider record whose `accountUrl` origin does not match the provider's documented sign-in origin is refused at boot. Applying-agent responsibility: The origin-check compares against the provider record's documented self-service origin; the applying agent sets the expected origin for each provider they configure.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider record for `google` whose `accountUrl` is `https://example.com/account`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provider adapter runs its boot-time validation
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot refuses with stable-coded `OAUTH2_ACCOUNT_URL_ORIGIN` naming the provider id and the observed origin; the record is not loaded

acceptanceCriteria.description: A provider that offers no self-service surface carries `accountUrl: null` and `credentialSelfService: false`; the applied capability set reflects `credentialSelfService` as absent for callers signed in through that provider.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider record whose `accountUrl` is `null` and whose `credentialSelfService` is `false`
acceptanceCriteria.when: a caller signed in through that provider invokes `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the helper returns `null`; the applied capability set does not report `credentialSelfService` as active for that caller's provider

acceptanceCriteria.description: No project route renders a credential-change form of its own.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied blueprint at v1.3.0 and a source-tree scan of the project's contributed pages
acceptanceCriteria.when: a static scan looks for `type=password` inputs or MFA-enrolment DOM shapes owned by the project
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan reports zero credential-input controls owned by the project; every credential moment resolves to a link out through `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl`
